en: The Pair on What is to be Abandoned by Cultivation (Bhāvanāyapahātabbaduka)
Dependent on a state not to be abandoned by cultivation, a state not to be abandoned by cultivation arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state not to be abandoned by cultivation, a state not to be abandoned by cultivation arises by way of root condition … three [combinations].
Dependent on a state both not to be abandoned by cultivation and not to be abandoned by cultivation, a state not to be abandoned by cultivation arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, there are five; in the object condition, two ... [and so on] ... in the non-disappearance condition, five.
